data.one_liner: Print tickets on 58mm/80mm thermal Bluetooth printers from Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter plugin to discover, connect to, and send print data to Bluetooth thermal printers on Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows. It handles permission checks and low‑level byte transmission for text and images.
use_when: You need to print receipts or tickets from a mobile or desktop Flutter app via Bluetooth
The target printer is a 58mm or 80mm thermal printer that supports standard ESC/POS commands
avoid_when: You require high‑throughput or network‑based printing (e.g., Wi‑Fi printers)
You need a pure Dart solution without native code
strengths: No location permission required on Android
Supports iOS/macOS with pure Swift implementation
Handles Bluetooth permission flow on Android 12+
Provides both byte‑level and string‑level printing APIs
weaknesses: Limited to Bluetooth printers; no Wi‑Fi or USB support
Some functions unavailable on Windows (e.g., writeString, batteryLevel)
Requires native configuration (Info.plist entries, entitlements, Android permissions)
data.setup_notes: Add NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription and NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription to iOS/macOS Info.plist; add com.apple.security.device.bluetooth entitlement for macOS; ensure Android manifest includes BLUETOOTH_CONNECT and BLUETOOTH_SCAN for Android 12+; import the package and call its static methods.
